provider_query: Open the Chiphell viewthread page and record whether the body is a captcha shell
answer:
**Record:** the Chiphell `viewthread` body is **not** a captcha shell on the pages that returned content. One raw `forum.php?mod=viewthread` URL came back empty in this fetch; that empty result is not a captcha page.

1. **`https://www.chiphell.com/forum.php?mod=viewthread&tid=2702990`** — tool body: “No content found” (1 line). Not a captcha form, not a thread.  
   Source: direct open of that URL.

2. **`https://www.chiphell.com/forum.php?mod=viewthread&tid=2702990&page=1`** — same empty result (“No content found”).  
   Source: direct open.

3. **`https://www.chiphell.com/thread-2702990-1-1.html`** (rewrite of the same thread) — full thread body: title, posts 1#–27#, reply box (“您需要登录后才可以回帖”), footer “Processed in … Gzip On, Redis On.” No captcha interstitial.  
   Source: [web:24](https://www.chiphell.com/thread-2702990-1-1.html).

4. **`https://www.chiphell.com/forum.php?mod=viewthread&tid=1`** — normal Discuz notice, not a captcha shell: “抱歉，指定的主题不存在或已被删除或正在被审核。”  
   Source: [web:26](https://www.chiphell.com/forum.php?mod=viewthread&tid=1).

5. **Login captcha is separate from viewing threads.** Thread [2522672] is about login “人机验证” / cookie issues, not a captcha wall on `viewthread`.  
   Source: [web:11](https://www.chiphell.com/thread-2522672-1-1.html) / [web:18](https://www.chiphell.com/thread-2522672-1-1.html).

6. **Post/reply captcha is a form field, not the page body.** A userscript only auto-fills the first captcha when posting or replying on chiphell.com.  
   Source: [web:13](https://greasyfork.org/ckb/scripts/26112-chiphell%E8%87%AA%E5%8A%A8%E5%A1%AB%E5%85%85%E9%AA%8C%E8%AF%81%E7%A0%81).

7. **Registration uses a text puzzle, not a viewthread shell** (e.g. “第 6–11 位 … 末尾加上 CHH”).  
   Source: [web:20](https://www.v2ex.com/t/738747).

8. **Same thread via search snippets** already shows post text and a `succeedhandle_fastpost(... mod=viewthread&tid=2702990 ...)` reply callback, i.e. a normal Discuz thread, not a captcha document.  
   Source: [web:8](https://www.chiphell.com/thread-2702990-1-1.html).
